# Building a Real Blog Table

#### Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage

## Building a Real Blog Table

Here's a simple table for our Learning HTML blog:

```html
1<table>
2  <tr>
3    <th>Tag</th>
4    <th>Purpose</th>
5  </tr>
6  <tr>
7    <td>h1</td>
8    <td>Main heading of the page</td>
9  </tr>
10  <tr>
11    <td>p</td>
12    <td>Paragraph of text</td>
13  </tr>
14  <tr>
15    <td>img</td>
16    <td>Displays an image</td>
17  </tr>
18</table>
```

Output

![Building a Real Blog Table](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Notice the following:

1. The first row is the table header and explains what each column represents
2. Every row after that is table row for data representing the header
